description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Masters Division at the 2023 World Championships, beaten in the final by Mew's Revenge, another of the four 2023 decks. Kirlia's Refinement Ability is its backbone, drawing cards and discarding Energy for Gardevoir ex's Psychic Embrace to attach again, and Iono can turn a game around. The 2023 World Championships were held at Pacifico Yokohama in Yokohama from 11 to 13 August 2023, the first in Japan and in Asia; 348 players from 36 nations played the card game there.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2023 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
